page_title: TOR 1-2 BOL | Torino v Bologna 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.

90+3' Bologna are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' The game has come to an end for Simon Sohm. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Lewis Ferguson (Bologna).
87' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nikola Vlasic (Torino) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
85' It is time for a substitution. Alieu Njie (Torino) is on for Luca Marianucci.
83' It's time for a substitution. Jens Odgaard (Bologna) comes on in place of Santiago Castro.
83' Saul Coco (Torino) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal.
82' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Federico Bernardeschi will be replaced by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna).
81' Torino are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
81' Simon Sohm (Bologna) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Fourneau and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Martin Vitik (Bologna) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
81' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
79' The game is interrupted now, Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Martin Vitik (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
78' The free kick is taken by Valentino Lazaro (Torino), but ball is cleared. Torino will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
78' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Torino are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
77' Handball by Duvan Zapata (Torino).

75' Nadir Zortea (Bologna) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Francesco Fourneau blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
74' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) replaces Jonathan Rowe.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joao Mario departs the field of play to be replaced by Nadir Zortea (Bologna).
70' 1 - 2 It's 1:2! Federico Bernardeschi feeds Santiago Castro (Bologna) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
64' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Francesco Fourneau to decide. The relieved Torino players can finally celebrate.
64' The Torino players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.

62' 1 - 1 Goal! Nikola Vlasic (Torino) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Lukasz Skorupski is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
61' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

60' Simon Sohm (Bologna) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the right post is smartly dealt with by Alberto Paleari. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' That's a well-taken pass by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
54' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Gvidas Gineitis and he is replaced by Cesare Casadei (Torino).
54' The referee signals a substitution. Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) is brought on as a substitute for Matteo Prati.
51' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) for his blatant foul.
49' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Nikola Moro (Bologna) introduces himself with a fine finish.
48' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
46' Marco Baroni makes a switch. Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is coming on in place of Zakaria Aboukhlal at the start of the second period.
46' Marco Baroni has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Duvan Zapata comes on the pitch for Che Adams (Torino).
46' Referee Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' What a chance that is! Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the right post.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.

41' Great solo effort by Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
37' Torino are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle and it's Giovanni Simeone (Torino) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
29' Martin Vitik (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
28' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) takes it short.

27' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.

26' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Alberto Paleari has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
26' Torino fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.

25' That's unlucky! Giovanni Simeone (Torino) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Torino have a corner.
23' Santiago Castro (Bologna) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Francesco Fourneau blows for a foul.
21' Alberto Paleari makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Santiago Castro (Bologna) after a cross from the side.
21' Bologna produce a short pass from the free kick.
20' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) picks up a yellow card.
15' The corner is swung in but Torino can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Torino get a corner.
7' Santiago Castro (Bologna) was too forceful with his tackle and Francesco Fourneau interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
5' Torino couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
4' The game is interrupted. Martin Vitik (Bologna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Francesco Fourneau.
